title: Reasoning-enabled retry of the private local-model trial
scope: Owner extends the private local-model test: rerun the same twelve frozen cases once on the held Qwen3-8B primary with reasoning enabled, apply the existing independent evidence gate unchanged, score against the separate calibration key only after generation, and inspect every answer. No reviewer model, spot checking, automatic retries, paid calls, source retrieval, downloads, public flags, deployment or bulk run; earlier failed evidence retained.
